editorial: Today, tools focusing on personal memory management and desktop AI agents are coming to the forefront in the developer ecosystem. While discussions on data sharing via Postman serve as a reminder of the importance of security and privacy standards, new language models and routing strategies are drawing attention on the Hugging Face side.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary: thedotmack/claude-mem is a tool that provides persistent context across sessions for AI agents. It compresses session data using AI to make relevant information available for reuse in future operations and works compatibly with various development tools such as Claude Code.

snapshot.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
items.summary: Developed by Vercel Labs, agent-desktop is a command-line interface (CLI) that allows AI agents to see and manage desktop applications on macOS, Windows, and Linux operating systems. Written in Rust, this tool uses the operating system's accessibility tree to enable agents to perform operations on the computer.

snapshot.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents. Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

items.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
items.summary: Worktrunk is a command-line interface (CLI) developed in Rust that simplifies Git worktree management. The software is designed to allow AI agents to execute parallel workflows more efficiently.

snapshot.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows. Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel.

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.summary: JustVugg/colibri is a hierarchical inference engine developed for frontier Mixture of Experts (MoE) models. Written in C, this tool enables models to be run on existing hardware by distributing model experts across GPU, RAM, and NVMe storage units.

snapshot.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: Mattpocock/skills contains AI agent skills used in real engineering processes and developed to support daily workflows. The project offers a toolkit focused directly on practical applications for automating software development tasks.

snapshot.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory. My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding.

items.title: p-e-w/heretic
items.summary: p-e-w/heretic is a Python project that allows for training-free modifications to language models. It enables users to remove censorship, reduce unnecessary content (slop), and lower the sycophancy of the AI model on a standard gaming PC.

snapshot.description: Training-free language model modification: Remove censorship, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more. Remove censorship, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more. All in an afternoon, on your gaming PC.

items.title: spotify/portal-ai-plugins
items.summary: portal-ai-plugins, developed by Spotify, enables the integration of the Spotify Portal system into AI-powered coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and pi. Written in TypeScript, these plugins facilitate developers' access to Spotify-sourced data within their working environments.

snapshot.description: Bring Spotify Portal into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and pi.

items.title: floci-io/floci
items.summary: Developed in Java, Floci is an open-source (source code accessible to everyone) AWS local emulator used for software development, testing, and continuous integration (CI) processes. It offers developers a free alternative by mimicking the services provided by the cloud computing platform AWS in a local environment.

snapshot.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative. Floci is a free, open-source local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI.

items.title: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor
items.summary: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor is a system that performs multi-task tracking and analysis on the second-hand shopping platform Xianyu using the browser automation tool Playwright and AI. Users can monitor products on the platform in real-time or on a scheduled basis through a web-based management interface.

snapshot.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。. 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控，提供完整的 Web 管理界面。

items.title: anomalyco/hex
items.summary: Developed in Rust, Hex provides local voice dictation capabilities for Mac, Windows, and Linux operating systems. It is a tool that allows users to speak by holding down a key and have the text pasted directly into the relevant field.

snapshot.description: Local voice dictation for mac, windows and linux. Hex is local voice dictation for Mac, Windows and Linux. Hold a key, speak, and it pastes.

items.title: D4Vinci/Scrapling
items.summary: Scrapling is a Python web scraping framework capable of managing all processes from simple requests to comprehensive crawling operations. It offers users the ability to perform scalable data collection through a single tool.

snapshot.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev

items.title: shiyu-coder/Kronos
items.summary: Kronos, specifically trained for K-line sequences which are the language of financial markets, is a family of foundation models developed to process high-noise market data. Unlike general-purpose time series models, this system uses a two-stage framework and aims to analyze the unique characteristics of financial data.

snapshot.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets. Kronos is a family of decoder-only foundation models, pre-trained specifically for the "language" of financial markets—K-line sequences. Unlike general-purpose TSFMs, Kronos is designed to handle the unique, high-noise characteristics of financial data. It leverages a novel two-stage framework: 1.

items.title: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
items.summary: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios transforms Claude Code into a comprehensive game development studio with 49 AI agents and 72 workflow skills. It aims to automate game production processes through a coordination system that reflects a real studio hierarchy.

snapshot.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.

items.title: Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and attempts to share all API data
items.summary: API development and testing tool Postman is being criticized for attempting to share all API data by installing AI plugins without user knowledge. This situation is sparking debate among users regarding the software's data privacy and security policies.

items.title: The 'Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen' post is misleading
items.summary: It is stated that claims regarding the Astra model's ability to read and write Qwen weights are misleading. It is expressed that the reading experiments conducted on raw weights and the techniques aimed at improving the Qwen model use completely different methods.

snapshot.description: The experiments that read raw weights and the ones that fix Qwen use completely different techniques.

items.title: Jailbreaking my car's navigation system just so I can change the time
items.summary: A user performed an unauthorized access (jailbreak) on their Renault brand vehicle's navigation system in order to change the clock setting. During this process, they bypassed the software's restrictions to intervene in the vehicle's built-in system.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
items.summary: The Qwen 3.8 27B model draws attention with its ability to directly read and process model weights. This capability brings to the fore a new programming approach (weight-space programming) where large language models (LLMs) can interpret neural network weights locally.

snapshot.description: Yesterday’s hot paper was Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, and Omar Khattab. The paper (OK, …

items.title: Stringman, an $800 open-source room scale gripper robot
items.summary: Stringman is an open-source (source code accessible to everyone) room-scale manipulator robot project that costs approximately 800 dollars. The project offers a cost-effective hardware solution for users to develop their own robotic systems.

items.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B
items.summary: Developed by LiquidAI, LFM3-1.7B is an AI model capable of text generation. Designed for local agents and specialized applications, this model is based on a newly developed tri-hybrid architecture.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

items.title: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B
items.summary: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B, developed by NVIDIA, is an open-weight automatic speech recognition model capable of transcribing in 40 languages. Operating with a mixture-of-experts architecture, the model can process audio recordings lasting up to one hour and offers a wide context window.

snapshot.description: automatic-speech-recognition model. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model for transcription in 40 languages, with support for recordings up to one hour and a 65,536-token context. Its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activates approximately 4.3B parameters, including the audio encoder, and it is released in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 precision.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: Published on Hugging Face, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is an AI model capable of processing visual and text-based data. It aims to reduce processing time and costs while providing performance improvements in reasoning, coding, and agent-based tasks compared to the previous version.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B
items.summary: Developed by Mistral AI, mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B is a multimodal AI model capable of processing visual and text data. Featuring a one-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture, this model was specifically trained in data centers in Europe.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Mistral Large 4 is our largest and most capable model to date: a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token (52 billion including embeddings and output layers), trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own datacenters in Europe.

items.title: speridlabs/idol
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face by Speridlabs, idol is a tool that generates 3D Gaussian splat models from a single image. Outputting a standard 3D file format (.ply), this model can run in under two seconds on consumer-grade graphics processing units.

snapshot.description: image-to-3d model. Idol turns one picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat. Give it a render, a generated image or a photo: it removes the background, frames the object and generates up to 1,048,576 Gaussians, written as a standard 3DGS .ply. It runs on consumer GPUs, using 7.2 GB of VRAM and can run in under 2 seconds.

items.title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
items.summary: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems presents a study on routing to different expert models and tools in general-purpose AI systems. It examines methods for achieving artificial general intelligence (AGI) by coordinating an ecosystem of specialized models instead of relying on a single model.

snapshot.description: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candi

items.title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
items.summary: Axion 1.0, shared by Hugging Face, is an open-source foundational AI model that combines broad agent capabilities with a simple training process. The model is trained through a two-stage supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning process, without the need for complex methods like direct preference optimization (DPO).

snapshot.description: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The first SFT stage develops strong self-contained reasoning through model-aware data construction, where we synthesiz

items.title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
items.summary: Caper, published on Hugging Face, is an approval mechanism that evaluates commands to be executed by autonomous coding agents with a result-oriented approach. Unlike existing systems, it makes security decisions by analyzing the state of the workspace and the behaviors the code will trigger, rather than just the text of the command.

snapshot.description: Coding agents increasingly rely on automated approvers to decide whether a proposed shell command may run. Existing approvers, from rule-based checkers to guardrail models and deployed permission classifiers, base their decisions on the text of the request and command. Yet a command's behavior depends on the code it invokes and the state of the workspace, and systems that observe file changes leave the assessment to the agent or a human after execution. We present Caper, a consequence-aware appr

items.title: What We Keep of What We Forget: Replacement Operators and Routing Semantics in Training-Free MoE Expert Pruning
items.summary: The paper shared by Hugging Face examines the processes of expert removal and managing router selections in training-free expert pruning methods. The study analyzes the impact of gate scaling of surviving experts on results by comparing different replacement operators on OLMoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight models.

snapshot.description: Training-free expert pruning makes two decisions: which experts to remove, and what the layer computes when its router still selects a removed expert. Published methods change both at once. Holding the mask fixed, we compare replacement operators from three families on OLMoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Moonlight, with Granite as a fourth router, using paired, multiplicity-corrected tests. The largest effect is a choice usually left implicit: the survivors' gate scale. On routers trained without top-k

items.title: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: The paper shared by Hugging Face examines concept unlearning processes in unified multimodal models. The study introduces a diagnostic benchmark called UUBench, which enables models to remove a specific concept from both visual generation and identification processes.

snapshot.description: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate image generation and visual understanding, but are existing single-pathway unlearning methods sufficient to suppress target concepts across both? In this work, we study cross-pathway concept unlearning. Our goal is to prevent a model from both generating images of a target concept and identifying it in input images, while preserving other capabilities. glossary.explanation: A data storage method that allows AI agents to remember previous conversations and ensures that information is not lost even when sessions are closed.
A text-based interface that allows you to manage programs by entering written commands instead of clicking with a mouse.
A hierarchical structure created by the operating system to describe on-screen elements to assistive technologies used by visually impaired users.
A Git feature used to work on multiple different versions simultaneously while developing software.
A concept representing the most advanced level reached and the most sophisticated capabilities in the field of artificial intelligence.
An architecture that allows a large AI model to produce more efficient results by activating only the relevant expert sections for each query.
The set of specific functions and skills that AI agents possess to perform certain tasks.
A method that can be used directly without the need to retrain the artificial intelligence model or update it with a dataset.
Low-quality, repetitive, or useless content generated by artificial intelligence that holds no value for the user.
The tendency of artificial intelligence to confirm the user's erroneous views or provide false information solely to please the user.
An automated development process that ensures software code is continuously tested and integrated.
The process of converting spoken audio into text by a computer in real-time.
The process of extracting and saving data from websites through automated software.
A comprehensive artificial intelligence model trained on very large datasets that can be used as a foundation for many different tasks.
The operational capabilities that artificial intelligence agents possess to manage complex business processes step-by-step.
The act of bypassing restrictions imposed by the manufacturer of a device or software through unauthorized means.
